mapper.sql: SELECT s.SEM_ID AS semId, s.SEM_YEAR AS semYear, s.SEM_TERM AS semTerm, CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(s.SEM_STR_DATE) AND TRUNC(s.SEM_END_DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS inProgressFlag, l.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, NVL(l.LEC_CREDIT, 0) AS lecCredit, pm.MEMBER_NAME AS professor, e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS AS lecStdEnrStatus, l.LEC_VAL_STATUS AS lecValStatus, t.LEC_TIM_DAY_CODE AS lecTimDayCode, TO_CHAR(t.LEC_TIM_STR_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS lecTimStrTime, TO_CHAR(t.LEC_TIM_END_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS lecTimEndTime FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN LMS_PROFILE pp ON pp.LMS_PRF_ID = l.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN MEMBER pm ON pm.MEMBER_ID = pp.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN LECTURE_TIME t ON t.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID

ORDER BY s.SEM_YEAR DESC, s.SEM_ID DESC, l.LEC_ID, CASE t.LEC_TIM_DAY_CODE WHEN 'MON' THEN 1 WHEN 'TUE' THEN 2 WHEN 'WED' THEN 3 WHEN 'THU' THEN 4 WHEN 'FRI' THEN 5 WHEN 'SAT' THEN 6 WHEN 'SUN' THEN 7 ELSE 8 END, t.LEC_TIM_STR_TIME
mapper.select: SELECT s.SEM_ID AS semId, s.SEM_YEAR AS semYear, s.SEM_TERM AS semTerm, MAX(CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(s.SEM_STR_DATE) AND TRUNC(s.SEM_END_DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inProgressFlag, COUNT(l.LEC_ID) AS courseCount, SUM(NVL(l.LEC_CREDIT, 0)) AS totalCredits FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID WHERE e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) >= TRUNC(s.SEM_STR_DATE) GROUP BY s.SEM_ID, s.SEM_YEAR, s.SEM_TERM ORDER BY s.SEM_YEAR DESC, s.SEM_ID DESC

SELECT l.LEC_ID AS lecId FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID WHERE e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND l.SEM_ID = #{semId} GROUP BY l.LEC_ID ORDER BY l.LEC_ID OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
